## `` com.cra.figaro.algorithm.filtering.BoundedParticleBudget.advise ``

[Full Scaladoc entry](../../target/out/jvm/scala-3.9.0/figaro/api/com/cra/figaro/algorithm/filtering/BoundedParticleBudget$.html#advise-ffffff93)

```scala
def advise(pilot: Pilot, request: Request): Advice
```

Return a conservative single-step work plan from a separate pilot; never executes production. Example: advise(Pilot(2000, 200), Request(maxCandidates = 10000)). Invalid inputs throw IllegalArgumentException; unresolved numerical calculations throw ArithmeticException (no plan). Default target 101 accounts for the discarded final success.

Type parameters: none.

## `` com.cra.figaro.algorithm.filtering.BoundedParticleBudget.runPilot ``

[Full Scaladoc entry](../../target/out/jvm/scala-3.9.0/figaro/api/com/cra/figaro/algorithm/filtering/BoundedParticleBudget$.html#runPilot-ad3)

```scala
def runPilot(attempts: Int, seed: Long, algorithm: Algorithm = ...)(draw: () => Boolean): Pilot
```

Execute exactly attempts Boolean draws using an owned RNG scope; callbacks must be IID. Uses util.random; never seeds or consumes the caller's ambient stream. Errors/interruption propagate without a partial Pilot. Example: runPilot(2000, 101)(() => random.nextDouble() &lt; .1).

Type parameters: none.

Parameters, list 1: `` attempts: Int ``; `` seed: Long ``; `` algorithm: Algorithm = ... ``.

Parameters, list 2: `` draw: () => Boolean ``.

## `` com.cra.figaro.algorithm.filtering.BoundedParticleFilter.elementModel ``

[Full Scaladoc entry](../../target/out/jvm/scala-3.9.0/figaro/api/com/cra/figaro/algorithm/filtering/BoundedParticleFilter$.html#elementModel-540)

```scala
def elementModel[S](initial: Universe => Element[S], transition: (S, Universe) => Element[S]): Model[S]
```

Adapt fixed, evidence-free Figaro DAGs to detached state draws. Each callback receives a fresh universe and must return an owned Element[S]. Use immutable S (e.g. tuples), not Element/Universe or mutable collections. Observations, conditions, constraints, interventions, external parents and dynamically created elements are rejected. Apply is supported; dynamic Chains are not. Example: elementModel(u => Flip(.5)(using "x", u), (x,u) => Flip(if(x) .8 else .2)(using "x",u)).

Type parameters: `` S ``.

Parameters, list 1: `` initial: Universe => Element[S] ``; `` transition: (S, Universe) => Element[S] ``.

Returns: `` Model[S] ``.

Source contract/attributes: Adapt fixed, evidence-free Figaro DAGs to detached state draws. Each callback receives a fresh universe and must return an owned Element[S]. Use immutable S (e.g. tuples), not Element/Universe or mutable collections. Observations, conditions, constraints, interventions, external parents and dynamically created elements are rejected. Apply is supported; dynamic Chains are not. Example: elementModel(u => Flip(.5)(using "x", u), (x,u) => Flip(if(x) .8 else .2)(using "x",u)). Attributes

Invocation template:

```scala
com.cra.figaro.algorithm.filtering.BoundedParticleFilter.elementModel[S](initial, transition)
```

## `` com.cra.figaro.algorithm.filtering.ParParticleFilter.apply ``

[Full Scaladoc entry](../../target/out/jvm/scala-3.9.0/figaro/api/com/cra/figaro/algorithm/filtering/ParParticleFilter$.html#apply-b8c)

```scala
def apply(static: () => Universe, initial: () => Universe, transition: (Universe, Universe) => Universe, numParticles: Int, numThreads: Int): ParOneTimeParticleFilter
```

A parallel one-time particle filter. Distributes the work of generating particles at each time step over a specified number of threads. After generating the particles, they are recombined before re-sampling occurs. Instead of accepting initial and static universes as input, this method accepts functions that return universes. This is because each thread needs its own set of universes to work on. It is important that any elements created within those functions are explicitly assigned to the returned universe, not the implicit default universe.

Type parameters: none.

Parameters, list 1: `` static: () => Universe ``; `` initial: () => Universe ``; `` transition: (Universe, Universe) => Universe ``; `` numParticles: Int ``; `` numThreads: Int ``.

Returns: `` ParOneTimeParticleFilter ``.

Source contract/attributes: A parallel one-time particle filter. Distributes the work of generating particles at each time step over a specified number of threads. After generating the particles, they are recombined before re-sampling occurs. Instead of accepting initial and static universes as input, this method accepts functions that return universes. This is because each thread needs its own set of universes to work on. It is important that any elements created within those functions are explicitly assigned to the returned universe, not the implicit default universe. Value parameters initial A function that returns a universe describing the distribution over the initial state of the system numParticles Number of particles to use at each time step numThreads The number of threads over which to distribute the work of generating the particles at each step static A function that returns a universe of elements whose values do not change over time transition The transition model describing how the current state of the system depends on the static and previous, respectively Attributes

Invocation template:

```scala
com.cra.figaro.algorithm.filtering.ParParticleFilter.apply(static, initial, transition, numParticles, numThreads)
```
